Get ready to unleash your critical thinking skills with the mind-boggling Maths Puzzle! 🚪🔢

Imagine yourself as a contestant on the most exciting game show ever. It's the grand finals, and you find yourself standing in front of three mysterious closed doors. Behind one of these doors lies the incredible, jaw-dropping final prize you've been dreaming of!

But here's the catch: behind the other two doors, there's absolutely nothing. Nada. Zilch. 🚪❌

Here's the challenge: You make your choice and select Door #1, trusting your instincts. Now, the game show host, who happens to know what's behind each door, decides to add a twist. They confidently open Door #2, revealing... nothing!

Now, here's where it gets really tricky. The host gives you an opportunity to reconsider. 

Do you stick with your initial choice of Door #1 or do you switch your bet to the remaining unopened Door #3? 

Mathematically which option gives you the highest chance of winning🤔

Take a moment to ponder your strategy and feel free to share your answer in the comments below. 

This puzzle will put your decision-making skills to the ultimate test!

But hold on tight because we're about to reveal the solution and unravel the mind-bending mathematics behind it in the pinned comment! 

Join the fun and tag your friends who love a good challenge! Let's dive into this puzzle together and see who can crack the code!

Off-Season Priority #1: 
Player Name: Immanuel Quickley
Age: Turning 24 tomorrow!
The Knicks need to do whatever it takes and give IQ all the money that he wants, and 100% sign him to his extension. During his time in New York since being drafted by the Knicks in 2020, with the 25th pick IQ has turned into a huge fan favorite and has shown he can become an All-Star in this league one day. This team is a really good team, and a huge factor to that being true is having IQ on the team and his presence and impact is HUGE. Quickley is coming off a career year, getting more and more minutes and playing even more. His scoring improved significantly and took a huge step along with his great passing, vision and defense which took a huge step and all of these areas kept getting better and better. Another thing about IQ was his leadership, he was a true leader and kept the guys going and showed true leadership since getting to this team. He was also the runner-up for sixth man of the year, and came close to even winning it which is remarkable with him being this young. He had some BIG scoring games this season, and showed huge improvement day by day going back to the beginning of the season and then going to the end point of the season. Some of his big games were, 40 against Houston, 39 against Indiana, 38 against Boston, 36 against the Spurs and etc. He had full confidence within the team to be who he is and do his thing which was very important. Quickley is eligible for a rookie-scale extension in July , which was the same type of deal signed by RJ last summer. I’m predicting a 4 year, $100 million extension for IQ, all I want for him to get what he wants and whatever makes him and the team happy. 100% EXTEND IQ, this isn’t even a question. GIVE THE MAN WHAT HE WANTS AT ALL COSTS! True fan favorite and loved by all Knick fans.

Flow

In the context of Self-transformation, one of the most important elements needed is Focus. Among the benefits of focus is that, it allows Your Mind and Emotions to be in the state of “Flow.” Simply put, “Flow” is a source of energy within You, both positive and negative energy. To be in “flow” simply means that both positive and negative energy are in equilibrium,….Balanced! When you are in “flow,” you make good decision. The same is true, when You Are Not in flow, poor decisions are the likely outcome. Flow is like a carefully choreographed dance,….there is time to Push,….and there is time to Pull. In flow, Self-awareness and Timing are everything. 

Do DM me if you have any queries on the many topics I have discussed, including this one. Also, please don’t hesitate to reach me if you need a bit of insights in your own journey, or perhaps someone you know and care about who needs help on his/her journey. 

Be well, be safe, stay focused, stay positive, stay humble, and keep going.

During a business conclave organized by the Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) and the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) on Tuesday, commerce ministers from various countries and provinces in the region expressed optimism that the trilateral highway connecting Bangkok with Kolkata as part of the BIMSTEC project could be completed within the next three to four years.
.
The proposed project plan for the trilateral highway involves starting from Bangkok and passing through cities such as Sukhothai and Mae Sot in Thailand, Yangon, Mandalay, Kalewa, and Tamu in Myanmar, before reaching India.
.
In India, the highway is expected to pass through Moreh, Kohima, Guwahati, Srirampur, Siliguri, and finally Kolkata, covering a total distance of over 2,800 km. The longest stretch of the highway would be in India, while the smallest stretch would be in Thailand.
.

In 2010, Aston Martin really did ask the question of: “How can we make a car worth 13k€ be worth 40k€ ?” 💸 And then decided the answer was to stuff 30k€ worth of leather into the interior.

The Aston Martin Cygnet is my favorite shitbox. Perhaps the most unlikely Aston ever but the least depreciating Aston Martin in history! Actually it’s a tuned Toyota iQ: S-curve grille (made from extruded aluminium) V12 Vantage (fake) hood vents or side grill with silver strip, rear led light… 

With 25 full grain leather interior color from the Aston Martin range (+ 14 optional Alcantara finishes) each Cygnet is unique, crazy spec for this one: two tones paint, dark blue / silver over Spicy red leather and chancellor red alcantara 🌶️ + German plates, Autohaus Tamsen sticker, a famous luxury car dealer (Bentley, Ferrari, Maserati or Aston Martin) in Bremen and Hamburg and delete Cygnet badge. AM produced just 786 cars during the whole production (2011-13) but one last fun fact: this one had Toyota front windows but… Aston Martin rear window!

أنا التفرد بينهم بل أنا الأعظم.
وأنا نجمٌ يسترشدُ بهِ صُحبي، حينما يَحجبُ السحابُ النجومِ.
